Purpose: Final acceptance boundary gate that establishes the hard limit of V16 phase readiness. No phase may claim readiness beyond ControlledReplay without explicit implementation of native production trace capture. This gate freezes the V16 boundary and prevents any artifact consumer from inferring production readiness.

BoundaryDefinition.HighestReadinessLevelDescription: FileSystem-backed controlled replay with seeded corpus (33 rows, 8 sections, 4 channels). WeightedPairwiseAcc=0.6504 >= 0.55. This is the highest proven readiness across all V16 phases.
BoundaryDefinition.ReadinessCapReason: NativeProductionTraceReady requires actual production trace capture against real production workspace/collection. No V16 phase has performed this. ControlledReplay is the ceiling.

NativeProductionTraceReadyPermanentUntil: Real production workspace/collection (not synthetic, not seeded)
Real user traffic (not controlled replay with seeded corpus)
Production trace captured (not plan-only, not simulated)
Production metric quality passed (not dry-run only)
ProductionGeneralizationReadyPermanentUn: Production metric quality passed on production data
LiveCaptureExecutionImplementedPermanent: All safety gates pass on production traffic
GateHardLimits.RuntimeInfluenceAllowedNote: PERMANENTLY FALSE. Neural bias is never activated at runtime. Package output is never modified. Vector binding is never changed. This is a structural invariant, not a readiness milestone.

PhaseTransitionRules.NextAllowedPhaseDescription: A design review must be held before any native production trace execution is attempted. The review must cover: production workspace/collection selection, privacy compliance, data retention, audit trail, rollback plan, and safety gate re-verification.
PhaseTransitionRules.NextDisallowedPhaseReason: V17 must not activate runtime influence. RuntimeInfluenceAllowed is permanently false. Neural bias, package mutation, and vector binding changes are structurally prohibited.
PhaseTransitionRules.PhaseCrossingGuard: No phase may cross from V16 to any production-runtime-influence state without passing through NativeProductionTraceExecutionDesignReview and all subsequent hard gates.
